blocks.text: Dadler er stenfrugter med højt indhold af kulhydrat og meget energi. De smager snerpende, når de er umodne, og bliver søde, når de er modne.

sourceRef.locator: Date chapter, Scientific Name and Introduction, p. 311
sourceRef.quote: It tastes astringent when premature and becomes sweet when ripe. Dates are rich in carbohydrate and other nutrients and are a high-energy food.

blocks.text: Jo mere fugt og varme, jo hurtigere bliver dadler dårlige. Ved 0 °C kan de holde op til 1 år; modne dadler tåler både kulde og frost.

sourceRef.locator: Date chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions; Chilling Sensitivity, p. 312
sourceRef.quote: Pathological and physiological deterioration increases with increasing moisture content and storage temperature. … At 0 °C (32 °F), dates can be stored in good conditions up to 1 year, but some varieties may develop sugar spots or crystals. … Ripe dates at the rutab or tamr stages (see Horticultural Maturity Indices), commonly handled in the world market, are not sensitive to chilling and freezing temperatures.

blocks.text: Dadler bliver mørke med tiden, hurtigere jo varmere og fugtigere de opbevares. Kulde og lavt vandindhold bremser det.

sourceRef.quote: Darkening is a major problem in dates. Its rate varies with cultivar, temperature, and moisture content; and it is affected by several treatments. It can be reduced by storage in low temperatures, low moisture content, or in an inert gas.

blocks.text: Modne dadler danner ingen ethylen og er ikke følsomme over for det.

sourceRef.locator: Date chapter, Ethylene Production and Sensitivity, p. 312
sourceRef.quote: At 20 °C (68 °F), dates produce less than 0.1 µL kg-1 h-1 ethylene at the khalal stage and none at the rutab and tamr stages. Ripe dates are not sensitive to ethylene exposure.

blocks.text: Delvist tørrede dadler holder 1 år ved 0 °C eller koldere, men kun nogle uger ved stuetemperatur. Bløde Deglet Noor-dadler holder højst 1 måned ved 27 °C, 3 måneder ved 15 °C og 8 måneder ved 5 °C, men over 1 år i fryseren.

sourceRef.locator: Date chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 312
sourceRef.quote: Fully mature soft and firm ‘Deglet Noor’ dates can be kept for more than 1 year when stored at -17.5 °C (0 °F) but will not stand more than 1 mo at 27 °C (80 °F), 3 mo at 15 °C (59 °F), or 8 mo at 5 °C (41 °F) (Rygg 1956). Partially dried dates can be kept for 1 year at 0 °C (32 °F) or lower, or for a few weeks at ambient temperature.
